editorial: If you crave a relentless blend of aerial stunts and detective intrigue, your adrenaline has a new playground. The Fall Guy lets its stuntman lead the hunt for a vanished actress while juggling career safety and romance. The practical stunt work showcases a bone‑cracking plane fall that feels earned for its visceral authenticity. Some viewers may notice a brief pacing slowdown when the plot shifts from chase to interrogation. Your time will be rewarded with an action‑thriller that balances danger and humor in equal measure.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of action-packed stunt shows with a bite of mystery.
